title: Bee Removal in Bellerose, Queens
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket removal in Bellerose, Queens. NYS DEC-licensed pest control serving Bellerose homes and businesses. Call today!
intro: Dealing with a wasp, hornet, or yellow jacket nest in Bellerose, Queens? Best Pest Control NYC provides professional nest treatment and removal services to protect your family and property. Our licensed technicians treat wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground-nesting bees — the stinging insects people call 'bees' — and refer honeybee colonies to licensed beekeepers.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has been serving the Bellerose community for years with insured technicians — each licensed by the NYS DEC or working under the direct supervision of a licensed applicator — who prioritize humane bee relocation whenever possible. We offer same-day service, transparent pricing.
localContext: Bellerose's beautiful residential neighborhoods, with tree-lined streets near the Queens-Nassau border and proximity to Bellerose Village, create ideal conditions for wasp and hornet nests in attics, eaves, soffits, and wall voids. From the classic homes near Hillside Avenue to properties surrounding Cross Island Parkway, our team knows the area's architecture and provides customized wasp and yellow jacket removal solutions for every Bellerose property type. Paper wasp nests under eaves, bald-faced hornet nests in trees, and yellow jacket colonies in wall cavities are common structural problems that require identification, treatment, nest removal, and entry-point sealing.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Bellerose?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you treat a wasp or hornet nest at my Bellerose property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and emergency service throughout Bellerose. Once you contact us, we can typically have licensed technicians at your property within 2–4 hours to assess the situation and begin nest treatment and removal.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Bellerose?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets return after the nest is removed?
faqs.answer: After we treat and remove the nest, we seal every entry point to prevent recolonization. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
